## Audit Complete

I've identified **one defect** and noted the regression listed in the police report.

**Finding:**

`new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_calendar_px1.dart:14` · empty-state label uses wrong constant (c0 instead of c1), will display "ריק אין פגישות השבוע" instead of requested "אין פגישות השבוע" · **P1 wrong result** · use `gen_app_calendar_px1_c1` instead of `gen_app_calendar_px1_c0`

The code currently passes `gen_app_calendar_px1_c0` which holds the particle name with marker prefix ("ריק אין פגישות השבוע"), but the task asks for just the message text ("אין פגישות השבוע"), which is correctly defined in `gen_app_calendar_px1_c1`.

**Regression noted (machine verdict: byte_identical_others ❌):**

`new/dart-gen-bs/gen_balagan_moments.dart` changed when only calendar.txt was modified. The calendar BalaganModule received updated TF-IDF scores and participants field. This is cascading regeneration (balagan aggregates calendar) and expected behavior from the generator, but violates the isolation test's byte_identical_others check.

**Coverage:**

✓ Participants field correctly added to spec, spec JSON, and generated screen code with proper indexing  
✓ Empty-state detection logic is sound (checks `appStore.records('app_calendar_ent1').isEmpty`)  
✓ Px1 particle screen created and routed into hub navigation  
✗ Constant bug: wrong label passed to EmptyState widget  
✗ Regression: balagan module updated (design ambiguity on whether cascading is allowed)
